Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:181234
Court No. - 75

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 38405 of 2023
Applicant :- Vikas Gupta

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Anand Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Umesh Chandra Sharma,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State-opposite party and perused
the record.

2. The instant bail application, under Section 439 Cr.P.C., has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the
applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 724 of 2015, under Sections 60, 62, 63, 72 of Excise Act and
under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 272, 273 I.P.C, Police Station- Akbarpur, District- Kanpur Dehat,
during the pendency of trial.
3.  Counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
The applicant is not named in the F.I.R.
There is one case against the applicant has been explained by him and in which he has already been enlarged on bail.
Another criminal case has been imposed upon the applicant, in which he had been arrested by the Police during the course of investigation, which is going on.
The accused-applicant was not arrested on the spot and nothing has been recovered from the possession of the applicant.
The applicant is in jail since 01.07.2023.
In case, he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.
